description: Homes listed for sale by owner (FSBO) on ForSaleByOwner.com for a US city: the first 20 listings with address, ZIP, coordinates, asking price (USD), property type, the owner's description (beds, baths, size and features as written by the seller), photo and listing link, plus the total number of FSBO listings in the city. Related tools on this server, for a different need: travel_autonation when you need AutoNation cars for sale for a make and optional model; travel_hostelworld when you need Hostels in a city as listed on Hostelworld's public city. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

maxPrice.description: Only listings at or below this price (USD)

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX
